notes.title: v2.1.3 Hotfix 1
notes.notes:
Hey guys as announced here it goes the new update. 
Changes:

- Minerals in front of buildings can't be driller. Now it's easier to access those buildings. 

- Upgrade buttons can't be clicked once you buy a better upgrade. If you click on it even with a better upgrade, the button will cancel itself and the upgrade wont be bought. 

- Drill now de-activates if no drill key is being pressed. 

- Render optimization threshold increased due to some reports for 2nd ship going under minerals. 

Hope you all enjoy as always.

Thank you!

notes.title: v2.1.3 Day Night Cycle Patch
notes.notes:
As requested by steam user DukeVonC, the day night cycle was changed.

Difficulty now changes the amount of time each day will take (in seconds) and also day and night were balanced.

Hope you all enjoy,
Thanks for your feedback.

notes.title: Patch Notes 2.0.3
notes.notes:
Hi guys, again thank you so much for the feedback, reviews and all the reports!

I know some of you may have experience world generation problems and this patch will fix it. If it doesn't please comment here and report me the error.

Change log:
- Map generation bug fixed
- Sound settings are now saved
- Minerals can be destroyed on inventory by clicking on them in the storage panel
- Fall damage buffed
- Fuel tank nerfed
- You can now use 'ENTER' or 'RETURN' to sell/fill tank
- antiAliasing is now controllable for 0/2/4/8x samples on Pause Menu.

Hope you enjoy the game.
Vitor.
